metadata.description:
Simple Media Browser
Custom media browser.
REQUIRES ReaImGui (install "ReaImGui: ReaScript binding for Dear ImGui" via ReaPack)
After install, restart REAPER. The action "SMB: Toggle media browser" appears in the Actions list.

version.author: DsgDnB
version.changelog: - Drag a fragment out of the waveform: select a region and drag from inside it to drop just that slice into the project or a sampler. - Playback follows the waveform selection: drawing a selection plays it, Play plays just the selection, and Loop loops it sample-accurately — even while you move its edges. - New "Skip leading silence" option (on by default): previews start where the sound starts. - Search box is now right on the toolbar — just start typing. - Search results can be grouped by folder (on by default); double-click a folder header to open it in the tree. - New All / Audio / MIDI filter in search. - Search stays fast on huge libraries. - Redrawn waveform: exact at any zoom level down to individual samples, with an optional split L/R stereo view. - Faster spectral waveform colouring; palette changes apply instantly. - ÷2 / ×2 buttons next to the BPM fix a tempo detected at half or double speed (shown while Sync is on). - Click a BPM or note badge taken from the file name to detect it from the audio instead. - New "Apply preview volume on insert" option, also applied to Cartridge as Gain. - Space now stops the sample preview first, then the project. - The folder tree stays smooth with thousands of files. - The footer adapts to narrow windows. - New "SMB: Undock window" action, and the browser now recovers automatically when docked into a docker squeezed to zero height. - Fixed a "tail" on loops dropped into the project with Sync on.

version.author: DsgDnB
version.changelog: - Linux: Fixed an issue where SMB could fail to detect ReaImGui even when it was installed. - Linux: Add Folder no longer depends on zenity and now uses REAPER's built-in folder picker. - Dragging a file into the arrange while SMB is docked now correctly returns keyboard focus to REAPER. - MIDI files no longer display BPM parsed from their filename. - Reduced occasional preview stutter by lowering the priority of background waveform/BPM analysis.
